summary: Single plastic hinge block: a flat tab with a rounded end and an M4-clearance hole, joined to a raised half-cylindrical barrel with a bore through it. The bore axis is perpendicular to the tab hole axis. The product image shows 25 loose pieces; this describes one.

mountingSurfaces.description: Flat underside of the tab and barrel base, which sits flush against a mating block or plate. The tab hole opens on this face.
Flat end face of the barrel, with the cross bore opening and a hinge-style mating face against an adjacent block.

notes: No dimensions are given in the text, so all sizes are estimates. Assumptions: the part is on the goBILDA 8 mm pattern, so the hole-to-hole spacing is probably 8 mm. The holes are sized for an M4 screw (about 4 mm), as the description says, and probably have slight clearance. In the top-view image the length is about 2:1 against the width, which gives roughly 24 x 12 mm. The barrel height is guessed at about 16 mm from the perspective view. The tab is probably 4-8 mm thick, and the hole positions are approximate. The grooves at 45° and the notches on the rounded end are visible but not modeled. Only the bounding box centering is stated; the part origin is assumed at the center of the box.
